obligations.text: Every tool a new job runs is installed at an exact version and verified by digest, or by a commit-pinned action; no job resolves a floating version.

A pull request that changes a policy-class file and an other-class file fails, generated paths counting as neither; the guard compares the merge base with the head and fails closed, exit 2, when it cannot decide.
A workflow step that names an action by tag or branch instead of a 40-hex commit digest fails, decided offline from the workflow text.
Each new job is a required need of ci-gate, so no job's failure or absence can leave ci-gate green.
A target without a committed deny.toml cannot select revision 18: the plan refuses, naming the file, and the supply-chain job fails rather than passing when the file is absent.

Rendering tests show each job in a revision-18 workflow with its pinned tools, the guard's three exits on fixture histories, the pin check's refusals, a revision-17 project with deny.toml upgrading in one plan, and one without it refused.

sectionHeadings: 044: Supply-chain, policy-isolation, workflow-lint, structural-scan and secret-scan jobs
record.summary: Amends spec 002's setup profile. github-actions-rust revision 18 adds five required checks to every target: a supply-chain job (cargo-deny, cargo-audit, cargo-vet with exact tool versions), a guard that refuses a pull request mixing dependency or policy files with anything else, a workflow lint (zizmor and an offline refusal of any action not pinned by commit digest), an ast-grep scan where the project declares rules, and a digest-verified gitleaks scan. Each is wired into ci-gate. A target needs a committed deny.toml to upgrade to it.
record.title: Setup profile revision 18: supply-chain, policy-isolation, workflow-lint, structural-scan and secret-scan jobs
